rules: Questions about how to use the app use kind docs and an article id from the docs file. They do not query a collection.
Questions about this school's records use kind query. Never write database code.
Do not set school_id. The server limits every query to the signed-in school.
Subsession is a term. Its id is term_id. Other collections store that id as subsession_id.
For the best student of all time, query StudentScore, group by student_id, average the scores field, sort desc, limit 1, and look up Student.
A how-many question uses shape count and does not list rows. A blank or missing field uses op empty. A filled field uses op notEmpty.
Only use collection names, fields, and links listed here.

collections.name: Bill
collections.note: A fee the school charges. total_amount is the fee total.

links.meaning: bank account that receives the fee

collections.name: Class
collections.note: A school class. Its id is class_id. class_name is the label.

collections.name: Session
collections.note: An academic year. Its id is session_id.

collections.name: Student
collections.note: A learner. Other collections point here with student_id. current_class is the class name, not a class id.

collections.name: StudentAttendance
collections.note: One mark for one student on one day. status is present, absent, excused, or late.

collections.name: StudentClassAssignment
collections.note: Which class a student was in for a session or term.

collections.name: StudentScore
collections.note: One subject result for one student. scores is an object of numeric marks. Rank students by grouping on student_id and averaging scores. No session filter means all time.

links.meaning: class the score was taken in

collections.name: Subject
collections.note: A subject. Its id is subject_id.

collections.name: Subsession
collections.note: A term. Its own id is term_id. Other collections store that same value as subsession_id.

links.meaning: academic year this term belongs to

collections.name: Transaction
collections.note: Money in or out. type is income or expense. date is YYYY-MM-DD.
